newsitem.title: USA: Bogen names new president/CEO, hires advisor.
newsitem.headline: Bogen names new president/CEO, hires advisor.

text.p: Bogen Communications International Inc on Monday said Zvi Peled has stepped down as the company's president and chief executive.
However, he was nominated to the board of directors of Bogen and will continue to be involved in the strategic development of Bogen, the company said.
John Egidio was appointed as acting president and CEO, director and member of the executive committee of Bogen, effective July 15.
Egidio last held the position of executive vice president of Geotek USA.
Bogen also said it will retain Helix Capital LLC as its business development and acquisition advisor.
